title: Not microfiber, Low Quality thin linens. Poor sewing.
text:
Not microfiber, Low Quality thin linens. Poor sewing.. From all the good reviews I bought these sheets. Big Mistake!
There thin, and fit my Cal King bed Sloppy. The stitching is poorly done. The sheets are not even cool for the summer when you first get in bed.
I think there suppose to be microfiber, I believe there not. I have bought microfiber linens before, and these Ain’t it.
Only one side has the pattern on it, which I have never seen before!
A Descent set of linens comes with 4 king pillow cases, Not two!

I can only say I like the silver gray color.
I would not buy these linens again.
One star.
